---
title: "Stacked Stage"
---

<!-- Six stacks of eight, which is more than reveal's overview view distance:
     some of these slides are always unloaded when the grid is open, which is
     what the touch overview's placeholders are measured against. -->

# Stack 1 is a column {#stack-1}

A level-one heading opens a stack; the level-two slides beneath it become its vertical children. This is column 1.

## Slide 1.1 {#stack-1-slide-1}

Row 1 of column 1. The overview grid is the only place the stage lays slides out in two directions at once, so this deck exists to be measured there.
